limits: Only the 69 named original Alpha images were visually reviewed; the remaining manifest images were not personally viewed here.
Long Excess Charge calculation text is assessed across the top and bottom viewport pair; one frame alone does not show the whole paragraph.
Chooser overlays obscure synthetic room geometry; actual class/rank/radius/room identity, no automatic action and explicit action timing come from the pinned passing native case.
Synthetic controlled crystal rooms, acquired-talent metadata and pylon/boss/rat state are not natural encounter generation, consumed-scroll or balance acceptance.
The unfinished-history fixture is a clean unsealed log with start and floor entries but no terminal record; it does not simulate a live crash or damaged tail.

Seed entry uses actual TextInput assignment and actual control submission. Latest queued replacement is covered, not completion of an already-running obsolete lookup. Original creator and physical keyboard behavior are not established.
Static Liquid Agility icons do not establish numeric defense or next-turn expiry; raw native assertions and markers establish those mechanics.
No physical phone, audio, install-over, new scoring or overall pair acceptance is claimed.

The original Developer seed test passed but its screenshot synchronization failed and pylon was not reached. Its original archive, logs and partial captures remain preserved; separate recovery is required.
